ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low; approximately 0.05:1 ratio of high-intensity white to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity (black/dark grey) contiguous region across >95% of surface; high-contrast light pixel clusters isolated at the extreme lateral distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped median notch with an estimated internal angle of 115 degrees and a shallow bounding-box depth relative to the fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Relatively smooth trailing edge with low-amplitude irregularities along the lobe span; significant high-frequency pixel jaggedness at the distal tips corresponding to epibiotic clusters.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Slight concavity observed along the trailing edge boundary from the median notch towards the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast light pixel clusters located exclusively at the far left and far right lobe tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive epibiotic growth (likely barnacles) visible as irregular, light-toned protrusions at the distal tips of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Uniformly dark ventral pigmentation lacking the characteristic white mottling common in this species.
